name: hud
description: Services, service overview, flow, function and investigation dashboards for applications instrumented with the Hud SDK in OTLP mode. Requires OpenSearch Dashboards 3.9 or later with Explore and dashboard variables enabled on self-managed installs; on Amazon OpenSearch Service, the dashboards run in an OpenSearch UI Observability workspace, and the domain's engine version (3.8 included) doesn't set the floor. Also requires a Prometheus or Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus direct-query data source named hud_amp with native histograms and the hud-hourly recording rules, and the SDK's hud.forensic log records in logs-otel-v1-*.
author: Hud
